results.title: Jerez
results.overview: No dia 12 de abril de 2025, 600 portugueses munidos de tambores, energia e muito álcool atravessaram a fronteira. Liderados por três humoristas e uma velha invadiram um jogo da quinta divisão espanhola e mudaram a história de Jerez de los Caballeros.  --  On April 12, 2025, 600 Portuguese people armed with drums, energy, and plenty of alcohol crossed the border. Led by three comedians and an old woman, they invaded a fifth-division Spanish football match and changed the history of Jerez de los Caballeros.

results.title: Finnegan's Foursome
results.overview: Two middle aged brothers and their respective sons travel to Ireland to play the Finnegan Family's annual golf outing, where they distribute the ashes of the family patriarch

results.title: Afterliving
results.overview: A woman arrives at The Bureau, a mysterious in-between, where her life is put to a test before her fate can be decided.

results.title: La vida és Verdi
results.overview: As Barcelona's Cines Verdi approach their centenary, two young girls explore its spaces and encounter the people who keep them alive. Through their eyes, the cinema emerges as a meeting place where generations of film lovers continue to share something that reaches beyond the screen.

results.title: Popeye II: Returns
results.overview: Sequel to Popeye's Revenge (2025). A military experiment goes catastrophically wrong when a test subject escapes after receiving an experimental enhancement serum. Now supercharged with deadly abilities, he descends upon an unsuspecting summer camp with violent intent.

results.title: Maria João Pires performs Mozart Lucerne Festival 2023
results.original_title: Maria João Pires interprète Mozart Festival de Lucerne 2023
results.overview: Pianist Maria João Pires and the Lucerne Festival Orchestra, conducted by Maestro Paavo Järvi, enchant the audience with Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s ‘Piano Concerto No. 9’, known as the ‘Jeunehomme’.

results.title: Tutti
results.overview: Rong Chen would like to keep her place in the recorder group, Shao Yu wants to give up playing. She asks him for tips, and by practicing together, they not only improve their skills, but also learn something much more important from each other.

results.title: Love at Lookout Lake
results.overview: Gossip columnist Sierra Rayburn heads to her childhood hometown to uncover the identity of the mysterious J.L. Warrington. There, she reconnects with Tyler O'Malley, her childhood crush, and begins to suspect he’s the secret author. As they grow closer, Sierra uncovers Tyler’s truth: he is J.L., writing under a pseudonym to honor his late wife. Torn between her career and protecting Tyler’s secret, Sierra writes a viral article that boosts both their lives, leading to a heartfelt kiss by the lake and a shared future.

results.title: A Clockwriter
results.overview: A screenwriter’s character manifests time, with each typewritten letter advancing the clock one minute closer to an encircling deadline.

results.title: Nelly Rapp – The Gateway to the Underworld
results.overview: When Nelly reunites with her mother, she learns that an ancient vampire intends to open the gateway to the underworld—where a slumbering evil waits to be unleashed. Together with Valle and London, they must stop the vampire before disaster strikes.

results.title: Peaky Blinders: The Real Story
results.overview: A behind-the-scenes documentary uncovering the real history of Birmingham’s Peaky Blinders, separating fact from fiction in the hit TV series and exploring the creative vision behind its unique style.

results.title: Love Is on the Way
results.overview: A "lying flat" youth exposes a loan shark, falls in love with a "super striver," and their turbulent romance overcomes various scams and financial disasters.

results.title: Sanxingdui: Future Past
results.overview: In the future, humanity receives a mysterious fragmentary intergalactic warning: Jiang Cheng and an ally must collect six Sanxingdui artifacts to complete the information, ultimately uncovering the secret that the female astronaut Xi Ling traveled back to the ancient Shu period, thereby reflecting the position of the Sanxingdui civilization in the origins of world civilization and the pattern of pluralistic unity of Chinese civilization.

results.title: Queer Edward II
results.overview: Spring 1991: As queer life is under attack in Britain, experimental artist Derek Jarman is turning Edward II into a radical protest film. Told through unseen behind-the-scenes footage, this is a story of the power and cost of queer visibility — then and now.

results.title: 7 Up! The Story
results.overview: 7 Up set out to prove that Britain was divided by class. Was this trailblazing social experiment right, and what does it say about the year, 1964, that it was made?

results.title: Vita Nova
results.overview: An ephemeral being lives for just one day: a ritual and fragile dance that celebrates the intensity, transformation, and beauty of fleeting moments.

results.title: The Voice of God
results.overview: Two child preachers search for a better life through the power of faith. 17-year-old Daniel, was once Brazil’s most renowned child preacher; today, as he nears adulthood, he grapples with the weight of an uncertain future. Meanwhile, 12-year-old João Vitor is at the height of his fame, reaching millions through his followers. Amidst livestreams and smartphones, he preaches to the masses. The film uncovers the childhoods concealed behind these public personas, reflecting a country in transition — a place where politics and religion frequently intertwine. As one cycle closes and another opens, they navigate a Brazil that has been forever changed.

results.title: 10éjszakás kaland
results.overview: Instead of ten commandments, ten intertwined Tinder dates: virtual relationships, bleak joys, fast-paced moves, spiritual deviance, hypocritical hypocrisy, perverse homophobia, lustful bloody revenge, and in the background a surprising twist that is far from being about joys...  This boundary-pushing independent film is not a traditional romantic story, but an experimental, provocative look at the 2020s, where the search for happiness is often just a swipe right away, yet it seems unattainable.

results.title: PL Stories: Henrik Larsson
results.overview: Henrik Larsson is one of Sweden's greatest football legends. Hear "Henke" reflect on his career and what qualities made him reach the world elite.

results.title: A Tale of Lost Times
results.overview: An ordinary school day turns into a fantastic adventure for Petya, Marusya, and Vasya when their idle time becomes the source of power for three old wizards. In pursuit of youth, the villains steal the students' time with a magical gadget, but in their haste, they themselves turn into children, and the children into helpless old men. To set things right, they must not only win the magical battle but also lift the spell before sunset, and most importantly, understand the value of every wasted minute.
